title: Water-tight casings.
officialText:
Each well shall be provided with a water-tight casing to a minimum distance of 10 feet (3048 mm)
below the ground surface. All casings shall extend at least 6 inches (152 mm) above the well platform. The casing shall be la rge
enough to permit installation of a separate drop pipe. Casings shall be sealed at the bottom in an impermeable stratum or extend
several feet into the water-bearing stratum.
